inputs.checklistItemText: Location of existing and proposed dumpsters and garbage carts (interior or exterior) not shown (SVC-01)
inputs.question: Are locations of dumpsters or garbage carts shown on this site plan? Look for labels or callouts indicating "dumpster," "trash," "garbage," or "refuse" locations, either interior to the building or exterior on the site.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether dumpster/garbage cart locations are present and labeled on the site plan at all (a feature-presence and label-readout check), not asking to measure distances or inspect drawing symbols/spatial relationships. This is a sheet-discovery and annotation presence question, not a measurement or drawing-element inspection.
